newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Air Charter Service forms Ostend unit.
newsitem.headline: Air Charter Service forms Ostend unit.

text.p: Air Charter Services Ltd has set up an office at Ostend airport, an airport spokesman said.
The English charter broker and general sales agent based in Kingston-upon-Thames now has two managers permanently stationed at the airport.
Until now Ostend has only been used for operational activities. ACS specialises in handling charter flights operated with Russian freighters.
ACS has already based an Antonov 124 from the Russian company, Polet at the airport and it is considering the possibility of basing another one there as well, said the spokesman.

ACS also represents the Russian companies, Atlant Soyuz and Titan Air Cargo. Titan has been operating flights on a twice-weekly basis for the past year, he added. The other Russian carrier is a new arrival at the Belgian airport.

The Antonov flights are mainly from Ostend to Latin America and the CIS, but ACS which has offices in Houston and Moscow, hopes to start a service to North America in the future. ACS is in negotiations with the New York airport authorities. he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
